absorption: The migration is permanently retired after every maintained environment has converged, or upstream provides an equivalent guarded migration/verification path for the same data model.

consumers.name: Explicit operator-driven migration of maintained Honcho workspaces into the family workspace.

contract: A reviewed manifest-driven operation can transactionally converge selected source workspaces into the canonical family workspace while preserving IDs, embeddings, reasoning/queue provenance, authoritative peer cards, excluded archives, failure state, rollback gates, and post-migration verification.

proof.fork_expected: focused tests pass and disposable-PostgreSQL rehearsal preserves IDs/provenance/failure state while satisfying final verification gates.
upstream: inspect workspace/identity migration operations on the recorded upstream base.
proof.upstream_expected: there is no equivalent manifest-driven guarded convergence operation.

replay: Never execute during ordinary startup or replay. Real use requires stopped writers, verified full-database backup, current production-data preflight, and post-cutover verification.
upstream_gap: The recorded upstream base has no migration operation for this local multi-workspace/identity convergence contract.
